zh.caption: 圖 1｜三項依據一起支持人的審查
zh.description: 規格、Diff、證據是平行核對材料；共同供負責人決定接受／要求修正／延後。下方箭頭表示彙整，不表示三者有先後順序。

items.title: 規格
items.body: 應該做什麼：需求、驗收條件與不做清單

items.title: Diff
items.body: 實際改了什麼：檔案、設定與行為

items.title: 證據
items.body: 是否有效：相關測試、操作與限制

items.title: 人的審查與決策
items.body: 接受／要求修正／延後

zh.caption: 圖 2｜Git 三個位置與操作
zh.description: 箭頭表示簡化操作：git add 將選定內容寫入暫存區；git commit 以暫存內容建立提交。HEAD 通常參照目前分支最新提交，不是儲存區。

items.title: Working Tree（工作區）
items.body: 目前正在編輯的實際檔案，如桌上草稿。下一步：git add，選擇放入下一版的內容。

items.title: Staging Area / Index（暫存區）
items.body: 已挑選、準備提交的內容，如整理好的送件版本。下一步：git commit，建立版本紀錄。

items.title: Repository 與 HEAD
items.body: Repository 保存提交歷史；HEAD 通常指向目前分支最新提交，如正式保存的報告版本。

zh.caption: 圖 3｜證據強度的差別
rows: 匯出測試通過，且實際下載內容核對正確

zh.caption: 圖 4｜五步審查流程
zh.description: 數字與連線表示建議審查順序；每一步都要依本次任務範圍實際執行。

items.title: 核對規格
items.body: 確認功能、驗收條件與不允許修改的範圍。

items.title: 檢查檔案變更
items.body: 查看工作區、暫存區、未追蹤檔案，必要時檢查 Agent 已建立的提交。

items.title: 檢查工具紀錄
items.body: 確認命令、目錄、退出碼、輸出與未執行事項。

items.title: 獨立驗證行為
items.body: 執行直接對應需求的正常、錯誤與邊界測試，必要時人工操作。

items.title: 留下決策紀錄
items.body: 寫下接受、要求修正或延後的理由及未解風險。

zh.caption: 圖 5｜review-notes.md — 範例
zh.description: 以下全為假設示例，不能視為已實測結果。

items.title: 任務
items.body: 資料檢核與報告匯出

items.title: 驗收要求
items.body: 缺漏資料不得產生完整報告。

items.title: 修改檔案
items.body: app.py、rules.py、tests/

items.title: 實際工具結果（假設）
items.body: 在表單切片執行 pytest，4 個測試通過。

items.title: 發現問題
items.body: 匯出時的重新驗證被移除；尚無證據顯示下載內容經過驗證。

items.title: 決策：要求修正
items.body: 理由：不符合驗收規格，現有測試不足以證明匯出功能正確。

en.caption: Figure 1 | Three inputs to human review
en.description: Specification, diff and evidence are parallel review inputs. Together they inform acceptance, revision or deferral. The downward arrow means aggregation, not a sequence between inputs.

items.title: Specification
items.body: What should be done: requirements, acceptance conditions and exclusions

items.title: Diff
items.body: What changed: files, configuration and behavior

items.title: Evidence
items.body: Does it work: relevant tests, operations and limits

items.title: Human review and decision
items.body: Accept / Revise / Defer

en.caption: Figure 2 | Git locations and operations
en.description: Arrows show simplified operations: git add writes selected content to the index; git commit records the index as a commit. HEAD usually references the current branch tip; it is not a storage area.

items.title: Working Tree
items.body: The files currently being edited, like a draft on your desk. Next: git add selects content for the next version.

items.title: Staging Area / Index
items.body: Selected content prepared for commit, like a delivery copy. Next: git commit creates a version record.

items.title: Repository and HEAD
items.body: The repository stores history; HEAD usually references the current branch tip, like the formally saved report version.

en.caption: Figure 3 | What the evidence supports
rows: Export tests pass and downloaded content is checked

en.caption: Figure 4 | Five-step review procedure
en.description: Numbers and connectors show the recommended review order. Execute each step within this task’s actual scope.

items.title: Check the specification
items.body: Confirm features, acceptance conditions and excluded changes.

items.title: Inspect file changes
items.body: Review working-tree, staged and untracked content, plus Agent-created commits where needed.

items.title: Inspect tool records
items.body: Confirm command, directory, exit code, output and unexecuted work.

items.title: Verify behavior independently
items.body: Run normal, error and boundary tests directly tied to requirements, with manual operation where needed.

items.title: Record the decision
items.body: Explain acceptance, revision or deferral and unresolved risks.

en.caption: Figure 5 | review-notes.md — example
en.description: Everything below is a hypothetical example, not an executed result.

items.title: Task
items.body: Data validation and report export

items.title: Acceptance condition
items.body: Missing data must prevent a complete report.

items.title: Changed files
items.body: app.py, rules.py, tests/

items.title: Tool outcome (hypothetical)
items.body: pytest in the form slice reports 4 passing tests.

items.title: Finding
items.body: Export revalidation was removed; downloaded content has not been shown to be verified.

items.title: Decision: revise
items.body: Reason: acceptance conditions are unmet and existing tests do not establish correct export.
